mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_account WHERE platform = #{platform} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND (cooldown_until IS NULL OR cooldown_until < NOW()) ORDER BY priority DESC, daily_used ASC

SELECT * FROM ai_account WHERE platform = #{platform} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND (cooldown_until IS NULL OR cooldown_until < NOW()) AND (daily_limit IS NULL OR daily_limit <= 0 OR daily_used < daily_limit) AND consecutive_failures < max_consecutive_failures ORDER BY priority DESC, daily_used ASC, last_request_at ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM ai_account WHERE platform = #{platform} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND worker_id IS NULL AND (cooldown_until IS NULL OR cooldown_until < NOW()) AND (daily_limit IS NULL OR daily_limit <= 0 OR daily_used < daily_limit) AND consecutive_failures < max_consecutive_failures ORDER BY priority DESC, daily_used ASC, RAND() LIMIT 5
